crossRefs.note: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
translations.bsb: Now Joseph and his father’s household remained in Egypt, and Joseph lived to the age of 110.
translations.kjv: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
translations.asv: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.
